instagram.reason: Instagram rate-limited the source IP after the first batch and returned HTTP 401 for ALL subsequent requests, including known-good handles (e.g. zuck, mercedesschlapp). The validator gracefully falls back to "valid" on 401 to avoid false-positive broken marks. As a result, the 274 instagram_status=valid records on this run are NOT independently verified.
instagram.recommendation: Re-run validate_links.py from a different IP (e.g. residential proxy or after 24h cooldown). Confirmed working signal: 200+JSON with data.user object = valid; 404 = broken.
